card.name: Digits inside years and numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly a single digit inside a year such as 19x2 or a number like 50 mg, in references and history text. Also fires on a few scattered words like Papers, State and which.

modes.label: Digit in a year

modes.description: A lone digit at the start of a dose amount or in a spacecraft name.

modes.label: Scattered words
modes.description: Occasional words in titles, university names or ordinary prose.
